fields.title: 8. Mission Control Data Record — Budget Recovery
fields.md:
- **What was done**: The cells rendered on screen had accumulated per-run history sentences. These were the note, status, check and prev fields of 13 triggers (T1, T3–T13, T16), the status of rule R5, and the progress sentences of 5 milestones (current for B-2027-1, C-2029-1 and E-2027-3; reasons for D-2027-1 and E-2027-4). The history was moved to off-screen cells (log_note, log_status, log_check, log_prev, status_log, current_log, progress_reason_log), leaving only the current state. **Nothing was deleted** (Source: `state.triggers_next_12m` · `state.milestones`).
- **Honest disclosure**: Whether this change passes the selftest can only be known once the publication gate runs it. The full per-run change history, `status_history` and `run_history` are unchanged, so the root-cause fix (caps, folding, separating the index) remains a decision for the Captain (Source: `state.open_questions_for_next_run`).
